initial.chief_complaint: Recurrent dyspnea days after drainage of a right pleural effusion.

presenting_complaint: Recurrent dyspnea days after drainage of a right pleural effusion.
history_freetext:
Two weeks of dyspnea and cough, briefly improved after an initial thoracentesis removed 1.5 L of milky right pleural fluid; recurrent dyspnea led to an ED return days later. No recent trauma or thoracic surgery.
45 pack-year smoking history.
